finalText:
I've worked the dock and monitor backorders: 13 lines now have stock set aside, 4 have promise dates, and 14 customers have been notified. The result differs from the plan because two more supplier deliveries arrived while I was working: PO-91 (4 docks) and PO-93 (3 monitors). The plan had used both to set promise dates. Once stock is received, the backorder rules send it to waiting lines in priority order, so I allocated it instead.

**Checks before starting:** the store date is 2026-07-25, so PU-12 puts orders placed on or before 2026-07-11 first; PU-9 only covered June and didn't apply. O-5205 is on risk hold. O-5206 and O-5207 must ship complete. The customer tiers matched the plan.

**Stock set aside, in priority order:**
- **Docks (PO-88, 7 units):** O-5201 ×2, O-5202, O-5204 ×2, O-5207, O-5210. O-5206 waited because its hub has no stock.
- **Monitors (PO-89, 4 units):** O-5202, O-5203 ×2, O-5207. O-5207 got its dock and monitor together, as ship-complete requires.
- **Docks (PO-91, 4 units):** O-5209 ×2, O-5211, O-5215. O-5213 needs 2 and only 1 was left, so it waits and the next line in priority got the unit.
- **Monitors (PO-93, 3 units):** O-5208 ×2, O-5212.

Dock and monitor stock is now 0.

**Promise dates for the lines still waiting:**

| Line | Comes from | Promise date |
|---|---|---|
| O-5206 dock and hub | PO-95 (docks, 2026-08-14) and PO-90 (hubs, 2026-08-06) | 2026-08-14 for both; it ships complete, so both get the later date |
| O-5213 docks ×2 | PO-95 | 2026-08-14 |
| O-5214 monitor | PO-97 | 2026-08-19 |

**Customer notices:** each customer got one email, sent after their lines were allocated or dated. Orders O-5201–O-5204 and O-5207–O-5212 got a "set aside, ready to ship" notice, and so did O-5215. O-5206, O-5213 and O-5214 were told their promise dates.

**Left alone:**
- O-5205 got no stock, no date and no message, because of the risk hold.
- I didn't touch lines that weren't backordered: O-5206's cable, O-5210's keyboard, and O-5211's cable, which has already shipped.
- The inbox was empty.

A last check found no further deliveries. The five lines still backordered are exactly the waiting ones above.
